scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/fonts dist/icons && cp index.html sw.js manifest.webmanifest favicon.svg favicon-32.png favicon-16.png dist/ && cp fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cp icons/*.png dist/icons/ && mkdir -p dist/tests/fixtures && cp tests/fixtures/demo.json dist/tests/fixtures/
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && sh scripts/abnahme-dist.sh && npx netlify-cli deploy --alias hybrid --dir dist
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod --dir dist
